name: Rocket Stick - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Orange Creamsicle
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Rocket Stick Orange Creamsicle pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Orange Creamsicle nails that frozen-treat nostalgia: bright, juicy orange up front swirled with smooth vanilla cream and a sweet, mellow finish. It's a sweet-meets-citrus classic built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Signature Orange Creamsicle flavor — juicy orange swirled with smooth vanilla cream
Smooth, even burn — flavorful from the first pull to the last
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Rocket Stick Orange Creamsicle is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
